# uk-open-data

> UK open data in Python for civil society, from charities and community groups to researchers and students. It loads public data from official sources and joins it to your own. It covers geographic boundaries, Nomis statistics, postcode lookups and deprivation indices for all four nations so far, with more datasets on the way. It also has analyses that answer a charity's questions from totals, a command line, and a connector for chat assistants over the Model Context Protocol.

- Install with `uv add uk-open-data` and import `uk_open_data`. `kindtech` is the old name.
- Statistics, postcode lookups, deprivation data and boundary properties (`geodata_to_properties`) share a `geography_code` column: join on it.
- Loaders return the DataFrame library you have installed (polars if you have both), so install pandas or polars yourself. `load_geodata` returns GeoJSON.
- The connector for chat assistants needs an extra: `uv add "uk-open-data[connector]"`, then `uk-open-data connector`.

## Docs

- [All docs in one file](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/llms-full.txt): every page below, as Markdown
- [User guide overview](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/index.md): the modules and how they fit together
- [Geographic data](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/geo/index.md): boundaries from the ONS Geoportal (LAD, LSOA, MSOA, ICB and more)
- [ONS data](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/ons/index.md): statistics from the Nomis API, with dataset aliases
- [Postcodes](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/postcodes/index.md): postcodes and outcodes to geography codes, through postcodes.io
- [Deprivation (IMD)](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/imd/index.md): each nation's official index, and a composite to compare across nations
- [Analyses](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/analyses/index.md): questions a charity asks of its own data, answered with totals, working and sources
- [Command line](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/cli/index.md): `uk-open-data analysis run` on a file, without writing Python
- [Connector for chat assistants](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/connector/index.md): the MCP server, its tools, and the rule that the assistant sees totals, never rows
- [Data sources](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/api/data-sources/index.md): the APIs behind each loader and their quirks

## Examples

- [ONS statistics notebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KindTechUK/uk-open-data/main/examples/ons_statistics.py): browse and load Nomis datasets (marimo)
- [Geographic boundaries notebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KindTechUK/uk-open-data/main/examples/geo_boundaries.py): explore UK boundaries (marimo)
- [Boundaries plus statistics notebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KindTechUK/uk-open-data/main/examples/geo_plus_ons.py): join boundaries with statistics (marimo)

- [Case studies](https://kindtechuk.github.io/uk-open-data/case-studies/index.md): DataKind UK charity projects rebuilt with this package
